body.name: Ambient endpoint extension \(\phi\)
body.construction: For a generic arm-cell vector \(v\), decode \(r(v),c(v),q_0(v),q_1(v)\) as in \(\mathrm{def{:}observable\mbox{-}mu\mbox{-}domain}\), form \(R(v),C(v),\ell(v),u(v),a(v),b(v)\), and evaluate \(B_-(v)=\sum_{d=1}^{L}\min\{u_d(v),\max\{\ell_d(v),a_d(v)\}\}\) and \(B_+(v)=\sum_{d=1}^{L}\max\{\ell_d(v),b_d(v)\}\). On \(\mathcal U=\{v:B_-(v)>\kappa/2,\ B_+(v)>\kappa/2\}\), define \[\phi(v)=\left(\frac{\sum_{d=1}^{L}(\ell_d(v)-a_d(v))_+}{B_-(v)},\frac{\sum_{d=1}^{L}b_d(v)}{B_+(v)}\right).\] Set \(\phi(v)=(0,1)\) outside \(\mathcal U\). For every \(v\in\mathcal V_{L,\kappa}\), define the common-domain endpoint functionals by \(H_-(v)=\pi_1\phi(v)\) and \(H_+(v)=\pi_2\phi(v)\).
